//: Typechecking for worker/src. There was no tsconfig here before: the only
typecheck script was `db:typecheck`, which compiled db/schema.ts with a
long flag list, and worker/src was never type-checked at all -- it was
exercised only by `node --test`, which strips types rather than reading
them. `npm run typecheck` now covers both halves.
`allowImportingTsExtensions` because every import in this directory is
written with a `.ts` suffix, which is what lets Node run the sources
directly (type stripping, Node 22+) with no build step. `noEmit` is
therefore mandatory, and bundling is wrangler/esbuild's job.
